name: Judgment Search Corpus Relevance
source: Hand-seeded solicitor queries with document ids verified against the local Find Case Law product corpus. Measured on POST /api/search/fetch, not the engine adapter.

scoring.held_recall: mean per-query recall@20 over held cases
scoring.held_precision: mean relevant-returned / returned over held cases
scoring.absent_precision: fraction of absent-citation queries returning zero results
scoring.mrr: mean reciprocal rank of the primary expected document on held cases
scoring.rank: 1-based position of each expected document, or null if absent from the top 20

known_limitations: Not a CI gate. CI has no product corpus; run pnpm benchmark:search-corpus locally against a ready legal_authorities index.

UKSC, UKPC, EWCA Civ and EWCA Crim are complete and expectations drawn from them are stable. High Court is 2020-onward and will gain pre-2020 material; a document-count change requires re-verifying absent-citation cases before updating the baseline.
The fixture benchmark in packages/search-client remains the CI engine-adapter gate. This suite exists because that fixture set cannot see fetch-layer drops on the real corpus.
Failing cases stay in the set. The baseline records today's ranks including misses; ranking work ratchets the floors.
